capture: Silent, synthetic motion only; editorial cards labelled; scene 3 cuts between real-time excerpts.

recording_captions.text: Practice on a cushion or manikin. Pace can drift when you practice alone.
CPR Pace Coach offers visual feedback from wrist motion. Practice only.

scenes.title: Get ready and try the demo

recording_captions.text: Set up a side-angled camera view with both arms visible.
Try demo uses generated landmarks. No camera or real person is recorded.
The same detector estimates pace. Voice controls are shown with a silent capture stub.
Steady at about 110 /min. These are real-time excerpts from one simulated session.
The pace falls toward 95 /min. The coach responds: Push faster.
Back in the target band. The coach returns to a steady-rhythm cue.
A three-second stop triggers Resume compressions and adds observed hands-off time.
Bent elbows trigger Keep your arms straight. Angles are 2D estimates.
The pace rises toward 125 /min. The coach responds: Slow down a little.
The completed result comes from detected motion: outside-band intervals and one stop.
Arm bending also appears in the summary. These estimates are not a lifesaving score.
Practice only, using a cushion or manikin. Depth and recoil are not measured.
Synthetic tests check detector behavior. Real-video and clinical validation remain unmeasured.
In a real emergency, call your local emergency number and follow the dispatcher.
The app exposes aggregate summaries for local tools.
This agent interface is a proposal, not a connected service.
Opt-in summaries only. No video shared, and missing values stay null.
Try the synthetic demo. Take one practice goal into your next session.
